claims.statement: Partner-alert labels are defined separately and their inline comment limits the feature description to public cloud repositories.
User-alert labels branch between fpt/ghec user-alert wording and other-version secret-scanning wording, with separate capitalization variants.
Generic alert variables resolve to secret-scanning alert labels, not a definition of closure, deletion or retention behavior.
The custom-pattern regular-expression generator variables supply display labels; they do not attest generator correctness or availability.
AI-detected and generic-secret-detection names are separate labels; names alone do not establish detection recall or equivalent product scope.
ROI and pricing calculator variables provide display names, not financial measurements or authority to spend.
The risk-assessment CTA defines a destination and action label; its maintenance comment requires consistency with a separately hardcoded index link.
The CTA source uses raw anchor markup with a nested label reference because its styling targets anchor classes; preserving markup intent is distinct from executing it or verifying rendered behavior.
Two learner fragments are expressly labeled dummy demonstration material without access; their source presence is not actual secret exposure or a verified push-protection behavior result.
